scheme_name: INSPIRe – Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research
overview: INSPIRE – Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research is a flagship programme of the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, aimed at attracting talent to the study of science at an early age and building a critical human resource pool for strengthening and expanding the Science & Technology system and R&D base. It comprises multiple components including Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE), INSPIRE Fellowship, INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship, and INSPIRE Internship Science Camps. The programme does not rely on competitive exams but uses the existing educational structure for talent identification.
objectives: Communicate to the youth of the country the excitements of creative pursuit of science
Attract talent to the study of science at an early age
Build the required critical human resource pool for strengthening and expanding the Science & Technology system and R&D base
Provide scholarships to meritorious students pursuing basic and natural sciences
Support doctoral research in basic and applied sciences
Offer contractual research fellowships to young achievers for independent research
Provide exposure to top 1% rankers in Class X through science camps
eligibility: Eligibility varies by component: For SHE, meritorious students with top 1% in Class XII pursuing basic/natural sciences; for INSPIRE Fellowship, 1st rank holders in PG/UG with minimum 70%/75% marks or INSPIRE Scholars with 70%/75% marks; for Faculty Fellowship, Ph.D. holders in science/math/engg/pharmacy/medicine/agri with age limits (32 for general, 37 for SC/ST/women, 42 for PWD); for Internship Science Camps, students in top 1% of Class X pursuing science in Class XI.
benefits: Benefits include financial support (scholarships, fellowships, grants), mentorship grants, research grants, contingency allowances, HRA as per GoI norms, DBT to SBI accounts, utilization of research grants for recurring/non-recurring expenses, and non-financial benefits like access to mentorship, research internships (up to 18 months), conference participation with prior approval, and opportunity to apply for other competitive grants during tenure.
financial_support: Financial support varies: SHE provides Rs. 80,000 per annum (Rs. 5,000/month scholarship + Rs. 20,000/year mentorship grant); INSPIRE Fellowship includes fellowship amount as per GoI norms (with HRA), contingency grant of Rs. 20,000/annum; Faculty Fellowship offers Rs. 1,25,000/month with annual increment of Rs. 2,000 and Rs. 7,00,000/year research grant; Internship Science Camps provide up to Rs. 7,000 per student and up to Rs. 10 lakh per Nobel Laureate mentor. Funds are transferred via PFMS to host institution’s ZBSA in Union Bank of India, then to fellows’ accounts per host institute norms.
application_process: 1. Visit the INSPIRE web portal at https://www.online-inspire.gov.in. 2. Check for active calls under the desired component (SHE, Fellowship, Faculty Fellowship, Internship). 3. Register/login on the portal. 4. Fill the online application form. 5. Upload required documents (mark sheets, endorsement forms, rank certificates, etc., as applicable). 6. Submit the application. 7. Await communication via portal notifications (provisional offer, rejection, or request for documents). 8. If provisionally selected, upload requisite documents within the time limit. 9. For continued support, submit annual performance reports, mark sheets, utilization certificates, and statements of expenditure.
required_documents: Class XII Mark Sheets (mandatory for SHE)
Class X Mark Sheet/Certificate (for proof of date of birth, mandatory for SHE)
Endorsement Certificate in prescribed format, signed by Principal/Director/Registrar (mandatory for SHE)
Eligibility Note/Advisory Note (if provided by Board, not mandatory for SHE)
Certificate specifying Rank or Award in JEE (Main)/JEE (Advanced)/NEET/KVPY/JBNSTS/NTSE/International Olympic Medallists (if applicable, mandatory for SHE)
All semester/year-wise UG/PG marksheets (combined in single PDF, mandatory for Fellowship)
First Rank Certificate in prescribed INSPIRE Fellowship Format (mandatory for Fellowship)
Ph.D. degree certificate or thesis submission proof (for Faculty Fellowship)
Undertakings (by Fellow and Host Institute) (for Faculty Fellowship)
Bank account details of Host Institute (for Faculty Fellowship)
Joining Report (for Faculty Fellowship)
Budget breakup on usage of Research Grant (for Faculty Fellowship)
Performance Report and Mark Sheets (annual/two semesters) for scholarship release
Utilization Certificate and Statement of Expenditure (Proforma 12A) for grant utilization
Mentorship Project Report and Certificate from Mentor (for SHE)
M.Sc. enrolment certificate (if extending scholarship to M.Sc.)
Registration Form for INSPIRE Internship Science Camp (for organizers)
Endorsement Letter from Head of Institute (for Internship organizers)
Zero Balance Subsidiary Account in Bank of Maharashtra with PFMS Unique Agency code (for Internship organizers)
Duly signed Mandate Form in prescribed format (for Internship organizers)
Budget estimate (for Internship organizers)
deadlines: Call for INSPIRE Fellowship applications is announced during the 3rd/4th quarter of each financial year. For SHE-2023 batch applicants who had not uploaded documents, the portal re-opened with a deadline to upload documents before 10th June, 2025. Internship Science Camp proposals must be submitted online minimum three months prior to the proposed date of commencement. Faculty Fellowship applications are advertised once a year in July/August.
implementing_agency: Department of Science and Technology (DST), Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India
caveats: Scholarship will be withdrawn if the course is discontinued, even if re-joined later
Scholarship forfeited if marks <60% or GPA <7.0 (10-point scale) in first attempt
No carry-forward of unspent Research Grant under Faculty Fellowship from FY 2024-2025 onwards (Hybrid-TSA Model)
Research Internship up to 18 months allowed only with prior permission from DST-INSPIRE
Host Institute must be registered under PFMS to receive Fellowship limit
INSPIRE Faculty Fellowship not renewable after 5 years
Transfer of Faculty Fellowship to another Host Institute allowed only once during tenure and only for permanent employment
Group mentorship projects not acceptable under SHE; only one per academic year
Mentorship project reports submitted after course completion will not be entertained
Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected
Unsigned bank passbook pages will not be accepted for SHE
